items.title: Open, closed, locally closed, constructible and locally union-of-locally-closed subsets of a Jacobson space are Jacobson
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file topology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement is the inheritance of the Jacobson property by the six listed types of subsets of a Jacobson space (author lemma at source lines 3641-3656, label lemma-jacobson-inherited), together with the assertion that closed points of the subset are closed in the ambient space. The proof (source lines 3658-3675) is organised around the auxiliary property that every non-empty locally closed subset has a point closed in the ambient space, which the author shows characterises the Jacobson property at once for all six cases and yields the closing sentence (proof lines 3659-3668); the verification is then uniform because a locally closed piece of any of the six types is locally closed in the ambient space (proof lines 3668-3675). H2.
